runtimeJs.name: web-llm-0.2.84-qwen-m5-lookahead.js
runtimeJs.role: Hash-verified WebLLM ESM runtime with K-step decode and WebGPU runtime-overlap flags; reused without duplication from the 1.7B lookahead-pass catalog artifact. This roll runs it with lookahead 0 (rejected for 9B, see provenance.md).

modelWasm.name: qwen35-9b-argmax-chunk256-sg32-tr64.wasm
modelWasm.role: Qwen3.5-9B model library with subgroup-32, chunk-256 full-vocabulary GPU argmax (compiler default; TVM_WEBGPU_GEMV_TR is a verified no-op for this model, so no TR value is claimed as a tuning choice)

modelResources.name: mlc-ai/Qwen3.5-9B-q4f16_1-MLC snapshot
modelResources.role: Immutable upstream weights, tokenizer and MLC chat configuration

notes: The existing runtime JS is reused by immutable URL and hash rather than uploaded again. The new model WASM is uploaded to this entry's own path and revision-pinned once published; the multi-file upstream model repository is independently revision-pinned. modelResources.bytes is the total size of all 135 files in the pinned upstream revision (per the Hugging Face tree API); only metadata/tokenizer files were downloaded locally to compile against, the weight shards were not duplicated in this worktree.
